purpose: Discover regulatory and market-authorization public records (FDA device listings) via offline fixture or replay pages.
inclusion: Public FDA device / clearance listing records with durable identifiers
Official EU or national public sources only where legal and technical access is explicit
exclusion: Inferring authorization, commercial availability, or clinical benefit from a listing alone
Treating eu_ctis scaffold adapter presence as programme completeness
Live HTTP inside the discovery package

identity_key.name: regulatory_record_id
identity_key.match_rule: Exact regulatory record identifier from the authoritative source. Conflicting same-id representations fail closed.

denominator_policy: Use source-reported totals when requested and consistent. Cursor termination is not registry completeness.
pagination_policy: Reject non-final pages without continuation tokens. fully_paginated is not recall.
known_identity_reconciliation: Optional regulatory id to source_id map. Exact matches emit DUPLICATE.
cadence: Human-gated. Offline fixture/replay only in this programme maturity.
raw_input_boundary: Caller supplies already-retrieved regulatory payloads. Discovery has no embedded live HTTP client.
human_review_path: Candidate proposals remain PENDING_HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE until adjudicate_candidate_source.

evaluation.precision_method: Sampled human review of NEW candidates (not executed by this software).

boundary: SU-REG offline programme execution emits candidates and coverage. A regulatory listing is not legal authorization, conformance, or deployment readiness.
